preconditions.description: The chessboard dimensions n must be between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
Alice's queen coordinates (a_x, a_y) must be within the chessboard dimensions.
Bob's king coordinates (b_x, b_y) must be within the chessboard dimensions.
Target coordinates (c_x, c_y) must be within the chessboard dimensions.
Bob's king must not be on the same square as Alice's queen.
The target square must not be on the same square as Alice's queen.
The target square must not be on the same square as Bob's king.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if can_reach_target_without_check(n, a_x, a_y, b_x, b_y, c_x, c_y) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if Bob can reach the target square without getting in check, otherwise 'NO'.
